Messages.Author: Dean Gilbert
Messages.Body:
1.  Certain cards require a vampire of a certain clan to be under
your control before you can 'use' a card.  Now, does 'use' mean
initially play from your hand, or actually use it in play.  

Example:  I take control of my prey's Ventrue HQ.  I do not have
any Ventrue under my control.  Can I use the HQ to gain votes?

2.  Can the hunting grounds give blood to vampires not of the
clan that is required in order to 'use' it?  Example:  Can
a Gangrel get the blood from a Warzone Hunting Ground?

--

Messages.Author: Al Orion
Messages.Body:
Yes to both questions. once a clan specific card hits the board, unless it
says usable only by a specific clan (ie Malkavian Madness Network,
Chantry, Eco Terrorist, etc.) it is usable by any vampire. so a hunting
ground can benifit any vampire you control and ventrue headquarters will
give you 3 votes when you tap it.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:

>1.  Certain cards require a vampire of a certain clan to be under
>your control before you can 'use' a card.  Now, does 'use' mean

>Example:  I take control of my prey's Ventrue HQ.  I do not have
>any Ventrue under my control.  Can I use the HQ to gain votes?

Yes.

>2.  Can the hunting grounds give blood to vampires not of the
>clan that is required in order to 'use' it?  Example:  Can
>a Gangrel get the blood from a Warzone Hunting Ground?

Sure.
